title: CanonicalEventRecord
description: Strict schema for canonical individual events recorded in .agents/state/events/TASK-xxx.jsonl and events.jsonl.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for the event, e.g. EVT-000019.

event.description: The type of event that occurred.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

source.description: The agent, role, or system component that produced the event.

taskId.description: The task this event relates to, if any.

phase.description: The execution phase when the event occurred.

details.description: Human-readable description or structured details of the event.

recoveryAction.description: Specific recovery action taken if this is a recovery event.

previousStatus.description: Previous task status before recovery or transition.

filesMutated.description: Files created, modified, or deleted during this event.

commandExitCode.description: Exit code of a command that triggered or relates to this event.

errorClass.description: Classification of the error, if this is an error event.

duration.description: How long the associated operation took (e.g., '12.3s').

stepIdx.description: Antigravity conversation step index where the tool was invoked.

tool.description: The name of the tool executed.

command.description: The command line or invocation arguments executed.

hasError.description: Whether the tool execution returned an error.

commandRedacted.description: Whether sensitive tokens or credentials were redacted from the command.

error.description: Error details if tool execution failed.
